Different tools are required to gather different parts of the tree:
 - Saw for logs
 - Branch Cutter for saplings
 - Shears for leaves
 - Knife for fruit
Better versions of the tools (Chainsaw, Grafter, ...) will increase the yield! Check the tooltip of the controller block for details.

You can even use multiple different tools together, and the machine will harvest several different products at the same time!

Note that the tools used will slowly lose durability, so for long-term operation you might want to set up some automatic replacement.

[note]While this machine only requires IV, it is quite expensive to make early in the tier. You will need 16 ZPM circuits and some fancy alloys.[/note]

Your attempts to improve your dimensional catalyst have been futile so far, but with the Raw Stellar Plasma from your Eye of Harmony, you can finally create a stable and more powerful catalyst.

You will need some higher-tier plasmas to help maintain its stability as well.

[warn]Handle with care. We are not responsible for your base turning into supermassive black holes. /s[/warn]

Redstone Dust is a wonderful substance, but it has several limitations that only true Minecrafters can handle.

Luckily, with a bit of magic the dust crystallizes and becomes much easier to handle.

Redcrystal can be placed directly against a wall or ceiling, and also allows you to use a wand to toggle whether a given side sends/receives any redstone signals. This allows for nice and compact builds in places regular redstone couldn't even exist in the first place.

Maybe it is possible to improve these redcrystals further to allow them to manipulate or process the signal they're receiving in some way...

Woah, another Energy Hatch.

You should probably consider upgrading your Assembly Lines and Precise Assemblers first.

So for some reason you have decided to pick the EBF option.

Well get ready for a processing line.

First you need to react Thorium Dust with Hydrofluoric Acid and eight buckets of Nitric Acid. I hope you have a Nitric Acid setup.

Then react the Thorium Nitrate with Sodium Hydroxide to produce Thorium Hydroxide. Then react with even more Hydrofluoric Acid to get Thorium Tetrafluoride.

Then pump it into a Centrifuge to separate the normal Thorium away from the Thorium 232. Sadly it is still in a liquid form so you will need to blast it with Zinc Chloride and Calcium.

Then finally use your Blast Furnace again for the Zn-Th alloy ingot to separate the Zinc from the Thorium 232 to obtain the Thorium 232 Dust and even get your Zinc back in fluid form.

Well I hope you enjoyed the processing line for Thorium 232 EBF edition.

With the project finally completed, and a new material capable of harnessing the power of a neutron star, you decide the natural first application of this immense power could be used for a far superior Blast Furnace. With a little tinkering, you decide a second may be necessary, since this module could easily be retrofitted into an ordinary Furnace as well.

[note]The first module of the Godforge, Helioflare Power Forge can perform EBF recipes and Furnace recipes in separate running modes, toggleable in the UI. Note that the Furnace mode does NOT contribute towards the Conversion milestone![/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the START upgrade.[/note]

To get this schematic you don't need to defeat any boss. You will still need to invest some time.

After researching a T8 Rocket Schematic you are able to build the Shuttle Schematic in the Assembly Line.

Arrange Nanites in P-507 and label them with target particle information in the high-energy laser beam environment of a laser engraver. Then we get the Extracting Unit called "Nano Resin" .

These Nanites automatically capture the target particles in solution and store them in the resin. It is worth noting that the actual production rate will be limited by the number of Nanites. So if you want to use this method to produce lanthanides in large quantities, you need to prepare more extra Nano Resin.

Here are all 15 types of Extracting Nano Resin.

If you've ever needed to wait on a Canning Machine to fill up your supply of tin cans, or for a Fluid Canning Machine to make mountains of coolant, consider the TurboCan Pro. This multiblock acts as both machines and has significant bonuses - when the time comes that you decide you need it!

To run the DTPF, you will need to feed it excited catalyst. There are four tiers of catalyst you can make right now, and one more to unlock later. Making these catalysts requires a lot of power and time, so you will almost certainly want to passive this with many machines.

In UIV, you will unlock the §p§oplasma mixer§r, a dedicated multiblock that can make catalyst much faster than you currently can, although this comes at an enormous power cost. Either way, it's probably a good idea to get this as soon as you can.

When you get poisoned or withered a bit of milk solves the problem. Why not create something akin to milk, but for Warp effects?

Briar gives a bit of an answer to that. These two block tall plants, which require good light to grow, will produce Briar Seed Bags when harvested. Those can be combined with sugar and a suitable container in an Arcane Workbench to create Rosehip Syrup.

Rosehip Syrup stacks up to 16 and can be used the same as milk, also removing some (though not all) Warp effects as well as Flux Flue and Flux Phage.

The plant has a strange life cycle where the seed pods will first appear as yellow dots, turn pink as they start to mature, then §odisappear§r, only to return fully matured. Still, if it works, it works.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Don't Tell Me I Need To Read A Paper Map!
betterquesting:10.desc:8: The Mothership Navigation Console is used to select the Mothership's destination.

The steam machines you have been using until now have served you well, but there will be a time when you need to process even more items. That's where the so-called multiblocks come in. There’s a variety of steam multiblocks available to you - go have a look at the Mass Processing quest tab! 

This tab introduces you to a wide range of extremely powerful multiblock machines that can replace your old, worn-out singleblocks (and some that can replace your old multiblocks!). Many of these new machines will require you to handle additional mechanics and requirements, but it will be worth it!

Here are some terms you should be familiar with as you enter the world of multiblocks:

Overclock (OC): 
If a machine can handle at least 4 times the voltage that is required for a recipe, it will overclock - causing it to require 4x the EU/t but also run 2x as fast. This can happen multiple times!

Perfect Overclock (Often phrased as "Does not lose efficiency when overclocked):
Some machines conditionally (or unconditionally) perform perfect overclocks: in this case, the machine will require 4x the EU/t, but it will run 4x as fast instead, leading to both increased speed and no net increase in the total eu usage!

Parallel (Often phrased as "Processes x items"): 
Machines which parallel act as if they are running multiple of themselves - that is to say, they are able to perform multiple of the same recipe at the same time, using the recipe's EU/t multiplied by the number of parallels. Machines which parallel will [warn]PRIORITIZE[/warn] this behavior over overclocking, which is good for you! Parallels are more efficient.

[note]When working with multiblocks, if power is interrupted during operation, your inputs will be lost forever... careful![/note]

Almost as expensive as the real one, right? Not to worry, this stargate and the current are only just the beginning.

[note]Our journey reaches the current end, entering the UXV, aka EOH era.

The year is 2023, and the game continues to be pushed further and further. The EOH exists now, along with machine parts up to UXV. Multiblocks have gained endless amounts of quality of life, including sub 1-tick OC, batch mode, void protection, and numerous AE2 additions like Crafting Input Buses, Stocking Hatches, Level Maintainers and more. Automation has never been easier, yet the goal has never been placed farther. Naquadah Fuel now has many tiers and can compete into the late-game, even competing with (now fixed) Dyson, but outclassed by the huge amount of power a maximized EOH can make (12.8 TEU/t!).

Initially the stargate recipe seemed impossible, requiring months of runtime on hundreds of maximized EOHs, requiring some adjustments to be more realistic to attain. After this was changed, the race began again, this time between §aJohny709§r and §aGDCloud§r. §aJohny§r burned out towards the end, and §aGDCloud§r was surpassed by a silent contender, §aStarStack§r, being the first to conquer this challenge on the §a26th of June, 2023§r.

Beyond just the first, this era marked the beginning of the Group Run Era, with large runs such as §aBallers Run§r (setting this era into motion), §aBee Run§r (affecting wide change on the NH project and its management as a whole), and §aCell Run 2§r (the fastest ever Stargate run, in only 73 days, popularizing many automation techniques like Level Maintained lines).

Additionally, this version saw the first player achieve GTNH Gods, reaching Stargate in a 3rd run, earned by §aGDCloud§r as a part of §aCell Run 2§r on the §a23rd of June, 2024§r. Later this Stargate would see three others reach this goal, §aRamspace§r on the §a29th of September, 2024§r, and §aStaffiX§r and §aserenibyss§r in a group run on the §a17th of November, 2024§r.

P.S.: Here's the list as usual:
-Many new processing multiblocks like HILE, Fluid Shaper, Industrial Autoclave, etc.
-Forge of the Gods, Black Hole Compressor, Antimatter power generation, Precise Assembler T4
-DTPF Convergence, Component Assembly Line tiered bonuses, Mega Vac Subspace Cooling, MK5 fusion skips for Metastable Oganesson
-Wireless Data Hatches, Wireless Optical Hatches, Uncertainty Resolution
-Artificial Universe Cells, smart blocking mode[/note]

display:10.Name:8: Pick this item up to get your trophy

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
SpaceTime is quite a challenge, isn’t it? You should definitely consider upgrading your Component Assembly Lines to save on some of it.

[note]Did you know you can wall-share the component casings? Just turn one CoAL upside down.

The CoAL will perform Perfect Overclocks for the recipes below its tier.[/note]

Cooling exotic ingots proves to be a much bigger challenge than smelting them.

Fortunately, reinforcing some of the casings with your new materials allows you to inject exotic coolants that capture extreme heat in miniature tears of spacetime, helping to cool your ingots a bit faster.

With Subspace Cooling, you can enable the Vacuum Freezer to achieve Perfect Overclocks… at a cost.

Tier 1 will consume SpaceTime in liquid form at [warn]7500 L/s[/warn] and allow for 1 Perfect Overclock.

[note]This cost is very high but static, remaining the same for each recipe being run. So, be selective about cooling your ingots.

The faster the recipes, the more efficient the cost, so find your optimal balance.[/note]

The Infinity Cooled Casings replace the Frostproof casings, so you don’t need to worry about damaging your setups.

Using your new optically enhanced boards and chips, you've managed to create what looks like the perfect CPU! Surely this will be able to handle even the advanced computations you need to perform to breach dimensional boundaries.

Are you sick and tired of using the rocket to blast off every time and want an alternative and faster method? The Enderio Telepad is a 3x3x1 structure that when powered with RF will teleport the player to a set coordinate.

To set the Coordinate you will need a Coordinate selector tool to mark an area by Shift right clicking to mark. Then Shift right click the middle of the Enderio Telepad pad to set the desired location.

Then stand on the pad and click teleport to be sent in style.

Now that you've reached ZPM, you're going to have to resort to means other than mere laser engraving for your photolithography needs.

Of course, we're going overkill right away, requiring a full-on particle accelerator setup to produce the ultra-coherent ultra-high-energy light used to etch more advanced ICs.

To begin with, you'll need a Source Chamber to produce electrons (at pitifully low energies, of course). Check out NEI for the available recipes, you'll want the one with the hand-drawn icon.

These hold 33,554,432 units of essentia.

And can hold 60 types.

Welcome to the current penultimate tier of New Horizons.

This tier is the tier for upgrading everything and provides access to better parts to help you scale up.

Good Luck.

[warn]This tier is not fully complete. Expect stuff to change.[/warn]

Is the Water Tank not cutting it anymore? Have you set up in a dry biome and are in desperate need of more water? Fear not, for the Steam Water Pump can solve your issues! This Multiblock is able to produce large amounts of Water if fed with Steam (1500L/s).

Like other Steam Multiblocks, it can be upgraded by using Steel Frame Boxes instead of Bronze ones, which doubles the Water output at no additional Steam cost.

§3It is, however, still dependent on how humid the Biome you are in is, so keep that in mind.

There are a plethora of ways to acquire gold, but here's one more for the dedicated apiarist. This breeding chain will eventually allow you to reach Sunnarium. You'll need a Block of Gold and a biome with a hot temperature. Breed them from Copper and Lead.

The Remote Comparator makes it significantly easier to get comparator signals out of whatever block you want, but looking at your storage chests you can't help but see no reason to bother. So what if they're nearly full? You want to know what they're nearly full §oof§r.

Tally Boxes can be pointed at a container - either directly or, using a Remote Comparator, remotely - and given a Runic Whitelist that specifies conditions where you want a Tally Box to send a redstone signal. Quantity, metadata and NBT matching are options, as is using a basic name filter.

Note that the redstone side is always opposite the reading side, and Remote Comparators must be placed on top of Tally Boxes to work together, meaning redstone is always output on the down face in that case.

[note]Runic Whitelists don't let you use NEI ghost items to set their filters, unfortunately.[/note]

Like its predecessor it can run 4 different recipes at once, but this time each recipe has 16 parallels.

A good solution for your Hydrogen and Helium problems.

[note]This also requires Eternity to craft.[/note]

Welcome to UEV! Now that you've started making your first infinity, it's time to start scaling up. In this tier, every component will require infinity. Be prepared to make tons. Your main goal to advance will be to build the Dimensionally Transcendent Plasma Forge, also known as the DTPF. This massive multiblock will unlock new powerful recipes to create infinity, neutronium and other special materials.
No Description

Well, maybe it's not as extreme as the quest name suggests, but it gets the job done.

You'll need one anyway so why not make one now and save some time on the mixing?

betterquesting:10.name:8: An Eye at the End of Time
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
So you have made yourself an Eternal DTPF or hopefully a few, and now it is time for the push to the next tier, UXV.

Introducing the final multiblock in the game, and by far the most expensive. 
It introduces 4 new materials: Raw Stellar Plasma, White and Black Dwarf Matter and finally Universium.

It has 3 different tiered casings with 9 tiers each: 

Spacetime Compression Field Generator:
- Determines the tier of the planet block that can be run and decreases the processing time by 3% per tier.

Time Dilation Field Generator:
- Decreases recipe time by 50% per tier, while decreasing the chance of a recipe succeeding by 9.25% per tier.

Stabilisation Field Generator:
- Increases the chance of a recipe succeeding by 5% per tier, while decreasing the output of a recipe by 5% per tier.

Lower tier Stabilisation Field Generators have a power output penalty.

Finding the best setup of different casing tiers might be a hard task, so a calculator visualing all the drops and setups has been created: [url]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15j30mNnFIWBhwpJGuDrKTfiHBXNEEqyvB_r7ztFWlyQ[/url]

[note]Be sure to read the tooltip of the Eye of Harmony controller, it explains everything in detail! Depending on your GUI scale it might have multiple pages.[/note]

Didn't expect the Rhugnor, did you?

As usual, mix your exotic dusts, blast them, form into wires, and superconduct.

Upgrades can be applied for pipes and modules, but an extra upgrade is needed if we need to apply upgrades to modules.

Here is the Upgrade Module Upgrade. But regardless of how many of these you stuff into a chassis, there will always be 2 module upgrades per module.

[note]Author's Note: Why is the Upgrade Module Upgrade the ONLY upgrade that has a more 3D-style texture while the other modules and upgrades are completely flat?[/note]

Wireless Computation is similar to Wireless Data, Cloud Computation Server Hatches send computation to Cloud Computation Client Hatches, which other multiblocks can use.

Place down a Server Hatch on a Quantum Computer, screwdriver the controller to enable Wireless Mode, then after placing down a Client Hatch, you have to set how much computation it should request from the Server Hatch.

[note]Wireless Data Hatches are N:M instead of 1:1[/note]
Want some blaze rods? Buy some!

The first step in the water purification process is the clarifier. Operating this machine is a simple task, you will just need to maintain a steady supply of Activated Carbon for the filters. Using this machine, you will be able to make Grade 1 Purified Water, which can spead up processing of Naquadah-Doped Boules and Wafers by 25%.

By combining various wireless terminals, you can create the ultimate 7-in-1 wireless terminal.

§3You can combine this with infinity booster card for unlimited range across all dimensions.
Now with fluid support!

As understanding of graviton shards continues to improve, better control over the materials they manipulate can be achieved. Graviton shards provide an alternative to electromagnetic containment of plasma using spacetime manipulation instead, allowing the Forge to directly output processed materials as plasma.

[note]The third module of the Godforge, Heliothermal Plasma Fabricator can directly convert materials into their plasma form, at the cost of an immense amount of power. This may not be ideal for every plasma, but can save a lot of time on particularly slow ones. Additionally, later upgrades allow the creation of exotic plasmas which cannot be created through other means.[/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the GPCI upgrade.[/note]
For the final circuit line currently in the game, you will need to make one last circuit assembler.

betterquesting:10.name:8: §b§lA Small Reward: The Infinite Spray Can
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Congratulations! You have completed the Platinum Line. Not many players have the perseverance to accomplish this task. A small reward is in order!

The [note]Infinite Spray Can[/note] never runs out of paint, and contains all sixteen colors (as well as solvent!) Of course, line mode and Ring of Loki support are included. There are also many convenience features. Middle click to open a color choice GUI. Middle click a painted block to copy its color to the spray can. Left click to cycle the active color (sneak to go backwards.) Sneak middle click to lock the can; while locked, you can't accidentally change the color. Sneak middle click to unlock. 

Naturally, you'll have to craft the infinite spray can yourself. It's a Dire Crafting recipe, so hopefully you have a dire crafting table. It requires a lot of platinum line materials, of course. And, apparently, a rainbow cactus, so a small detour into magic will be necessary. And a bunch of random-looking AE2 parts. And an IV world accelerator. And... a fence?

Is this really a reward?

With your research now complete, you have finally constructed it - the Forge of the Gods.

The Forge of the Gods is an immensely powerful structure constructed around a stabilized neutron star - it is so advanced that its full capabilities are not yet understood. However, through continued use, one can slowly upgrade and expand the range of abilities of the Forge, and learn the power hidden in the most extreme parts of the universe: [note]Graviton Shards[/note].

This esoteric material can only be found where conventional matter and degenerate neutronium crust matter on the surface of a neutron star meet. At this point in space, gravitons are far more common and irradiate this material mixture to create highly unstable graviton shards, which can be used to internally upgrade the Forge. While these shards cannot yet exist outside the extreme conditions of the Forge, with continued research and utilization it may be possible to eventually isolate and extract them outside the Forge - but for what purpose?

[note]Click on the logo in the UI to read more on how to operate the Godforge.[/note]
Check the NEI pages to see all the nice recipes this machine can handle for you. Great to craft GT components in bulk.
After automating Absolute Baryonic Perfection Purification Unit, you slowly start getting Stabilized Baryonic Matter, at a rate of 500mb/parallel every 120 seconds.

So you were looking at Thorium 232 and wondering how to make it?

You could centrifuge it at a horrible chance rate with a long recipe but there are better ways of obtaining it.

The better ways are processing chains that can be made in three different paths with the third path being unlocked at a further stage after obtaining Fusion with the Neutron Activator.

The first path requires the chemical plant multiblock that you might not be familiar with but will become required to create rocket fuel for any tier three or higher rocket. This path is the fastest with only two steps to obtain the Thorium 232, but requires borax which can only be obtained (for now) through mining salt veins as a byproduct or through bees (probably the better option if you already have some).

The second path is a six step processing chain that requires Chemical Reactors, a Centrifuge, and an EBF. Even though it is longer it offers much better conversion ratio (75% instead of 25% in chemical plant), instead of borax it requires nitric acid (4000L per dust if you account for recycling) and 100L of fluorine per dust.

Either way I would recommend using AE2FC as it allows on demand fluid crafting which will assist in both processing chains.

Better modules will require a more advanced Space Elevator motor to function.

This upgrade will allow you to access 15 modules on your Space Elevator. If you haven't built the expansion yet, now might be a good time.

[note]You can enable the Space Elevator expansion in the GUI.[/note]

This bee produces nothing directly but instead sacrifices its lifetime to generate liquid essentia for all your magical needs. To do so, however, it requires an Apimancer's Drainer beneath its housing.

The speed at which the bee produces essentia is affected by its production speed. You have to right-click the drainer with a filled phial of the desired essentia to lock it to that type.

You can breed them from chaotic and ordered bees.

§3You can also place up to 9 drainers beneath a single alveary as long as the blocks at the bottom are plain alveary blocks.

A helper material needed in some UMV and UXV components. Have fun making millions.

[note]This is extremely slow to make and to process.[/note]

You have probably already seen the button called §6Optimize Patterns§r when making an order in your AE system, now it's time to put it in the good use!

To unlock this feature, just add a Pattern Optimization Matrix block to your AE system (you only need one).

§l# What does it do?
§r
This feature allows you to multiply patterns that are needed in large amounts.

1. After calculating a big order, just click §6Optimize Patterns§r and you will be welcomed by a new window.
2. There you specify how much you wish for a singular pattern to be ordered (maximum amount of steps), we recommend putting it at 1000 or 100, [warn]remember that over-optimizing patterns could lead to longer waiting times[/warn]. At this point, you can also disable singular patterns from optimization by clicking on them, but there shouldn't be any unwanted patterns anyway if you already excluded them by toggling a button in unwanted interfaces.
§

3. Click §6Optimize§r and you are done! Try ordering again to see the changes in pattern steps

All changes are [warn]permanent and can't be reverted automatically[/warn] so make sure that you have excluded all unwanted interfaces (the §6Allow Pattern Optimization§r button is §7GRAY§r) like:
- Single Assembly Line interfaces
- Extreme Crafting interfaces
- And any interface that doesn't have (almost)infinite buffer at the other side (inf. chest/storage cells)
Patterns are only multiplied by powers of 2, so your AAL patterns should be safe.

[note]If you are still confused about maximum order steps here's an example:
Ordering an EOH calculates that it will need 1,000,008 UHV superconductors crafted (41667 steps, 24 UHV SC patterned), now you proceed to optimize patterns and specify that you wish it to do 1000 steps maximum, it will multiply your pattern 64 times to achieve that goal (41667 / 64 ~= 652 which is lower or equal to 1000). After clicking optimize, UHV SC pattern will now output 1536 UHV SC (24 before).[/note]

After managing to create an artificial universe capable of storing near-infinite amounts of items, you applied this same technology to your Fluid Digital Singularity Cell to create this truly magnificent piece of tech. This allows you to store up to 5 different types of fluids without the universe collapsing in on itself.

Time to scale up production! In HV, a handful of new powerful multiblocks are available to you. In particular, take a look at the §lLarge Chemical Reactor§r, which always perfectly overclocks, as well as the §lDistillation Tower§l§r, which will allow you to get all byproducts from distillation instead of targetting just one.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Wireless Data for Your Assembly Lines!
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Wireless Data Bank Transmission Connector and Wireless Assembly line Reception Connector lets you avoid building and connecting dozens of Data Banks and Optical Fiber Cable for the upcoming Assembly Llines you might have to build.

To use it, you have to screwdriver the Data Bank that is storing the data sticks, place a Wireless Data Bank Transmission Connector into the Data Bank, then Wireless Assembly line Reception Connector for the Assembly Lines.

[note]Wireless Data Hatches are N:M instead of 1:1[/note]

Here's the special Titanium I promised you. GT++ materials enter the fray here, both with this and the Titansteel you need to add to that to make what comes next!

That step only comes after fusing Niobium and Zinc into Krypton Plasma. You get a rarer noble gas here than before, the next one will be Xenon. This recipe matches in speed with the next one, which uses Krypton to make Astral Titanium Plasma, by adding in the final plasma of the previous chain, Force Plasma! That's right, each chain needs everything from before to continue. 

Once you have Astral Titanium Plasma, you can move on to the final mk2 step.

As usual, before you can make use of your Americium to make better wafers, you will need better water. This time, we're going to use plasma to rapidly heat up the water and then cool it back down.

Some of the mechanics may seem similar to how you set up the pH neutralization process, maybe you can expand on what you learned there?

[note]This multiblock is very picky about where its plasma and coolant input hatches go. If you can't figure out why it's not forming, chances are you forgot to place these hatches in the correct location. Use the hologram projector to see where they go.[/note]
You have two options here. Either you followed the NaK quests or you made a vacuum freezer to cool helium.

...but a very useful meter.

GT EU Meter will give you basic information about electricity in your cables and machines.


[note]A more advanced version is available in MV and will allow you to gather much more data, so come back to this tab later to find it.[/note]

NEI now automatically collapses similiar items into one slot making browsing much faster! To collapse/uncollapse a group use ALT+LMB.
You can also create your own presets with custom groups!

[note]You can disable this functionality in NEI settings[/note]

Also now NEI has JEI-like Advanced Search:

@ - search by mod (@minecraft)

[note]There are even more special characters that you can use but most of them are off by default (e.g. no need to use # to search in tooltip), below are all the special characters, check which ones are on/off in NEI settings.

Space is used as a logical AND between different conditions
# - search by tooltip (#UV-Tier)
& - search by id: (&95:15 extratrees:door)
$ - search by ore dictionary ($ore)
% - search by subsets (%block)
| - logical or. multi-item search (wrench|hammer)
- - logical not. exclude items that match the following expression (-@minecraft)
" - multiple words wrapped in quotes are treated as one condition rather than several ("White Stained Glass")

Search Mode (apply on search parts, not full string):
Plain - simple string
Extended - allow only ?, * rules (by default)
Regex - allow full regex

In Extended Search Mode:
? - any character (@min?craft)
* - any few characters (@m*ft = @minecraft)
r/.../ - standard java regex (@r/m\w{6}ft/ = @minecraft)[/note]

[note]You can disable this functionality in NEI settingss.[/note]

You can add bookmarks with the A key while hovering over an item, also:
Hold SHIFT to bookmark the whole recipe
Hold CTRL to bookmark number of items
Hold SHIFT + CTRL to bookmark both recipe and all the number of all the items it contains

...but they can be as industrious as bees. These new electric friends are great companions for MultiBlock machines: maintenance, control, management—they can do it all.

§lThe Drone Center is a newly designed machine. It doesn't need power; just put a drone into it and then it will run.
Once running, drone will automatically scan for a '§lDrone Downlink Module§r' (replacing maintenance hatches on MultiBlock machines) within a certain range and attempt to establish a connection with the host. If successful, you can remotely control this MultiBlock machine from the Drone Centre GUI! Additionally, you can rename the machine for easier identification.

[note]You can rename it either by right-click the Drone Downlink Module or in Drone Centre GUI.[/note]

Placing more advanced drones will increase the range of central control, with no limit on the number.

[warn]Notice that drone may crash during operation—the probability decreases from Tier 1 to Tier 3, and Tier 3 Anti-Gravity Drones never crash.
Besides, If the machine host is too far from the Drone Center, the GUI remote control function will be disabled, but the turn-on/off-all-button and maintenance functions will still work.[/warn]
§6§l
Maybe one day, our drone can control machines on other planets...drive engine online!

[note]Hurrah, you can finally move on to the UMV tier![/note]

The residue produced from the DTPFs seems to have an interesting interaction with reality, as if it bends the universe to its will.

What if you combined it with some infinity and hypogen to excite it, and an energized tesseract as a way to fling it back and forth to the 4th Dimension?

Maybe then you could achieve the unachievable, a building block of the entire universe.

[note]The base recipe is horrible, so definitely make the Eternal Coils for your DTPF first.

Congrats on making it this far![/note]
A bit expensive, but worth the QOL items you can craft with it.
Bigger, better, faster. The Large Electric Compressor does about what you would expect.
No Description

Automating crafting table recipes is a good first step to automate your processes. 

To achieve this goal, get yourself a crafting logistics pipe and a logistics crafting table.

You can import a crafting table recipe into a logistics crafting table and you can click the "import" button on the crafting logistics pipes GUI that is connected to the crafting table to import the recipe into the pipe.

You should have quite the collection of single block Steam machines by now. While these may have gotten you through processing small amounts of materials, there will be a time when you will have to process a multitude of items. This is where Multiblocks come in.

While these Multiblocks have a material cost that is way higher than their single block counterparts, they have certain bonuses: they use less Steam, and they can process recipes in parallel, which means that a single recipe cycle can craft multiple items at once, if the Steam provided is enough to sustain it.

§TThey do however have some quirks that need to be taken care of:

-These Multiblocks require §4§lvery specific§r I/O blocks, use only those that are part of the quest 
-They process up to 8 items, where the Basic Tier is made of Bronze and High Pressure Tier is made of Steel (checkout the Multiblock Preview in NEI which will show you different levels of tiers)
-The Tier and amount of parallel processing can be seen via WAILA if you are looking at the Controller Block

§W[note]With this quest, you have started your journey with Mass Processing. However, don't get too excited quite yet. While there are some Multiblocks accessible in the Steam Age, most of them only unlock in EV or later, including better versions of these Multiblocks.[/note]

Stocking bus but better!

This one can pull first 16 types of items automatically from ME network, which can be useful for some automations. Minimum stack size and refresh time can be configured in the GUI.

[note]Using this on your main network is probably not a very good idea.[/note]

If you want to go further than Mars you need a better rocket fuel. From here on out there is only one choice. The Chemical Plant is at the heart of the production. If you dont have one yet, you should have a look at it. It has 4 separate tier system and might be a bit over whelming at first, but there is a minecraft book that can tell you everything about it. Also check out the quest for the Chemical Plant in the GT++ quest tab.

[warn]Don't use the NEI Preview for the Chemical Plant, it is wrong.[/warn]

This magnificent breed of Bee produces a whole plethora of useful resources, including endless amounts of Lapis, Energium, and Lapotron Dust. However, they are somewhat picky when it comes to breeding; you'll need Energium and Lapis Bees as parents, and the process must take place on the Moon under icy temperatures.

The Draconic Fusion Crafted has 5 tier of casings, each an upgrade of the previous tier.

Each new tier of casings allows you to make better Cores, eventually ending at the Chaotic Core.

[note]Recipe time is divided by number of tiers above recipe tier![/note]

betterquesting:10.name:8: Use Nano Tech to produce Lanthanides
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
After unlocking Carbon Nanites, we can now use it to extract the needed lanthanide resources in large quantities.

Of course you better be ready. It's expensive until you got the Nano Forge.
Another Field Generator... you are almost done.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Does It Contain A Black Hole?
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Artificial Gravity Generator allows you to change the gravity around it to your liking. The Artificial Gravity Disruptor disables that behaviour for whoever has it equipped and enabled.

[note]Surely this can't be used with malicious intent...[/note]

These hold 524,288 units of essentia.

And can hold 24 types.

The Mark of the Falling Tower is among the most powerful magic you can achieve in GTNH. It allows you to summon a huge meteor full of various GT ores right were you want it. All you need is a particular catalyst item and a good amount of LP. Even better, you sometimes get access to ores before you could get them normally! Check out NEI for all the possible meteors. For example you can start by looking at the uses of a Pufferfish.

The meteor requires at least a singular block to see the sky above the master ritual stone. You can use the alchemical component Terrae to increase the radius of the meteor by 1. Using Orbis Terrae increases the radius by 2.

The meteor deals some damage but it does not deal environmental/block damage. Just be weary if you have villagers or important mobs nearby. The size of the meteor also increases the damage & radius by an enormous amount.

A multiblock miners can mine out the various ores spawned from the meteor, but there are other options too!

While the Forge Hammer is quite fast already, why not build this upscaled version and make it even faster? With the Steam Presser, you can unleash the full force of steam on whatever material you feed it. Watch blocks break apart and rods get smashed together faster than ever-at least until you gain access to more advanced technology.

§3The Steam Presser can only process recipes up to LV Tier.

UEV superconductors, another great infinity sink. You can make the celestial tungsten and advanced nitinol in a laser engraver directly, but this is quite slow. Perhaps consider using the celestial tungsten plasma line?

The advanced machines you are now creating require more advanced materials, as well as more advanced ways to process them. In ZPM, you can construct the Hot Isostatic Pressurization Unit, an upgrade to the Large Electric Compressor. This multiblock heats material to extreme temperatures under extreme pressure, allowing it to create superdense plates with minimal imperfections.

The HIP Unit heats up while it is running, and must be given some time to cool off. If it reaches its maximum heat threshold, it will significantly slow your recipes or even void the inputs. Use better coils to increase how long it will take to overheat, and use Heat Sensor Hatches to automate it properly.

[note]Can perform compression recipes which say "Requires HIP Unit" in NEI.[/note]
No Description

One of the last wires you have to make for now.

[note]Hope you're not using these for hooking up power to your pre-existing machines. Consider the Infinity Wire.[/note]

You want to start using your new Europium to make even better wafers, but it turns out that your old methods of creating purified water are no longer enough. You will need to use the Flocculation Purification Unit to make even better purified water first. To run this machine, you will need large amounts of Polyaluminium Chloride, but luckily you can get all your Chlorine back if you properly recycle the waste liquid.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Your Lord and Saviour, UXV CoAL
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
You want to rush this as soon as possible.

Every L of Universium matters.

Works like stocking input bus but for fluids.

[note]You need only one to complete the quest.[/note]

After embracing the dark side you get access to the new even bigger dark steel chest... perhaps another upgrade will be available in the future?

[note]Just as with the previous chests you can also upgrade with a fitting upgrade item.[/note]

The IndustrialCraft2 Teleporter allows for teleportation between 2 connected teleporters.
It requires energy storing block right next to it due to the massive power demand.

[note]The energy required is determined by the distance between the teleporters and amount of items in the inventory.[/note]

[note]The teleporter is quite buggy according to the official wiki.[/note]

betterquesting:10.name:8: §6§lOne Fluid Tank to Store it All!!
betterquesting:10.desc:8:
If you ever thought that the standard super tanks or quantum tanks were still too small then the YOTTank is the next option.

The YOTTank compared to the TFFT might only be able to store one fluid instead of 25 fluids. However it makes up for this downside by not having to share any of the fluid storage space with any other fluids. It also does not require any energy input or maintenance requirements.

If all you want to do is store a large amount of one fluid type then look no further then the YOTTank. It has a special ME input hatch for ae2 connections while having expandable storage blocks. The tank can be both upgraded with the fluid storage blocks and can be increased in height to hold any more fluid.

So if you want to store your fluid in style then look no further then the YOTTank.

[note]If you're having issues searching for the fluid storage blocks for the YOTTank in NEI then search for: fluid cell block[/note]

Once you have the two plasmas from before, fuse them together into a new one, Neon Plasma. If you were to use this directly, you could get Neon! There are other, more useful materials to get later in this process, so keep a lookout for those.

However, this is not the final plasma in mk1 recipes. To get it, you need to do the last activation step, which exists in all three chains, and involves adding a non-plasma related material, of the appropriate GT tier, to obtain the powergen plasma. The material you need here is Arcanite, one you probably have used before. This step requires you to preferably automate it with ABS, and have a steady supply of Thorium 232.

If you look at the last recipe, you'll see it's 144L Neon Plasma input to 1000L Force Plasma output. This multiplying makes it so that step, and all final steps, are the slowest ones. You will need 0.144 Neon Plasma reactors for every Force Plasma reactor, which means that 1 Neon reactor feeds nearly 7 Force reactors (6.9444... reactors, more precisely).

Once you get Force Plasma, this is the end of the mk1 fusion chain. Force Plasma is a 150M fuel value plasma, which means it has a 53.5% penalty with Infinity Catalyst in XL Plasma Generators. This is better than Helium Plasma with its 86.1% penalty but still not great for power generation. You probably don't need this in ZPM, but it'll be a stepping stone for your future progression.

A lot of recipes take fluids. But crafting modules only have slots for items...

Introducing the Fluid Crafting Upgrade. It will allow you to allocate one kind of fluid for the craft. Drag one fluid cell containing the fluid you need into the fluid slot and set the correct amount.

Don't forget to bind it to a fluid satellite pipe. The way it binds is identical to the satellite logistics pipe.

These hold 2,097,152 units of essentia.

And can hold 36 types.

First available in LV, the Mob Repellator prevents mobs from spawning in its radius. It works without power, but with it has a higher range.

[note]You only need one to complete the quest.[/note]

Once you get ZPM tier power (2 LuV energy hatches), this method is much better.

Melt the Samarium Chloride and reduce it with Lanthanum in a Distillation Tower. Then recover Lanthanum Chloride by electrolysis.

Now that you've enjoyed your exotic cookies, let's keep going, shall we?

Welcome to UIV! One of the shortest tiers in NH for now. This tier is mainly about solving your DTPF catalyst problems and getting to Eternal Coils.

There are a few QOL additions introduced, like the Uncertainty Resolver and the Thaumometric Essentia Cell.

You also gain access to the Dyson Swarm, an incredibly powerful power generation option.

[warn]This tier is not fully complete. Expect changes.[/warn]

With Shirabon now acquired, you can finally create catalysts to use in your Tier 4 QFT.

[note]These are extremely expensive, you may want to look into DTPF convergence, and faster means of creating Metastable Oganesson before you can make many of these.[/note]

Sick of having to swap out lenses or make tens of laser engravers for your cleanroom? The Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver is here for you. This multiblock can handle all of your engraving needs.

By using more powerful §lLaser Source Hatches§l §rin the structure, you can gain more parallels and run higher tier recipes.

Created by all tiers of the Eye of Harmony, Raw Stellar Plasma can be used for several things including Stellar Catalyst.

[note]You may want to be careful with this material, as later running EOH's with Astral Arrays requires this instead of Hydrogen and Helium, so make sure to never fully run out![/note]

If you have a stable Samarium resource acquisition, refining Samarium Ore should be the best way to get Samarium.

As the first step, disolve some Samarium Ore Concentrate Dust or Crushed Samarium Ore (you probably don't have access to this option yet) in Nitric Acid in a Digester to get Muddy Samarium Rare Earth Solution. Thorium and Phosphate are retained in the form of a solid slag powder. 

Then transfer the muddy solution to a Dissolution Tank and continue to soak it in nitric acid. The undissolved powder is then meticulously filtered out, yielding some Cerium.

Then dilute the result with water to adjust the pH.

If you want to pursue the breeding path toward Lapotron and Pyrotheum Bees, you’ll need to start by breeding some Furious Bees. They can be bred in the nether using Fiendish and Embittered Bees, with the latter found in the wilds of the Nether.

Beware: Furious Bees spawn fire charges downward, so make sure your breeding area is fireproof!

From now on, you’ll be dealing with extremely slow recipes.

Consider finishing up your QFTs and upgrading or replacing your old infrastructure to save on TPS.

You should definitely upgrade your power generation and infrastructure to handle millions of recipes.

The Eye of Harmony will be consuming most of your power before it starts generating more than it uses.

May Colen have mercy on your soul.

[note]Welcome to the waiting lounge.[/note]

After seeing how slow Shirabon is to make, you might want to upgrade your Fusion setup.

Like its predecessor, the MK4, this version also supports Perfect Overclocks. Hopefully, this will make your Metastable Oganesson issues a bit more manageable.

[note]You can specify the batch amount in the GUI if you don’t want it to handle one-tick recipes.[/note]
This is the last capacitor so we can't get much higher unfortunately.

Fabricating Crystal SoCs with LuAG is so much faster than directly engraving crystal chips! They can also be used for Raw Advanced Crystal Chip.

Remember to keep some LuAG gems for growing more crystals.

You might already have a Steam Multiblock or the Large Sifter. But in EV, IV, and the following tiers you unlock multiblocks for (almost) every GT machine. And some more on top of that!

Most of them are made to do the same GT processing as the singleblock machines you've been using, but much faster. The multis can have up to three bonuses: energy savings, faster recipe time and parallels, which mean that a single recipe cycle can craft multiple items at once, if the power provided is enough to sustain it.

The variety of structures and intricacies of these new multis can go far beyond simpler multis like the EBF, LCR or VF. While some are simple cuboids, others come with more diverse mechanics and conditions to work properly. In return, they can be extremely powerful, so keep an eye out for them!

betterquesting:10.name:8: A Better Way To Generate Oxygen
betterquesting:10.desc:8: This is an all-in-one solution to generate oxygen. Just provide power (continous) and Seeds (once).

In HV, you now technically have the ability to construct Megas for some machines. These absolute titans will boost your production to levels never-before-seen, at a price. These multiblocks have two major benefits:
-They innately have 256 parallels.
-They can use TecTech exotic hatches, allowing you to empty out tremendous amounts of power into them.

[note]To get real benefit from these multis, you will want to use lots of power and take advantage of their extreme parallelization - consider whether or not you can actually make use of these before you go off building a Mega Blast Furnace in HV...[/note]

Definitely consider this for the improved Magnetohydrodynamically Constrained Star Matter recipe. You’ll also need it to make MHDCSM parts.

Kickstarting the loop is expensive and RNG-based. You need 20,736 L of Universium for the first 5 attempts and a catalyst.

The QFT recipe has a 25% chance of yielding Eternity per attempt. You should probably boost the QFT with plasmas and focus on producing Eternity.

[note]Did you know the QFT has a fluid mode? It could be useful for extracting molten Shirabon. Just right click the controller with a §ascrewdriver§r.[/note]

[note]Building a full beacon out of Eternity Blocks might be a bit extravagant, don’t you think?[/note]
Let's make some NaK coolant!

Now that you have Titanium, why not make about 79 EV machine casings for some cheap Ammonia? The ratio is about 50mb to one Golden-Brown Algae. At EV you have a 10% chance to get 8 about every 30 seconds. It also does not require a Chemical Plant, but it will require an MV Assembler and an MV Fluid Extractor at minimum.

After meddling with the 4th Dimension, you've finally discovered a way to access its unlimited Essentia supply. The Thaumometric Essentia Cell is your tool for extracting Essentia from this boundless source—think of it as your unlimited magic credit card.

Unfortunately, you must filter each type of Essentia in your Essentia Cell Workbench. If only your technology were more advanced...

So you want to move essentia from your Alchemical furnace to your warded Jars without getting it all gunked up with different essentia types?

Well you came to the right place, with the use of buffered tubes and your handy wand you can move your essentia in tubes to fill all your jars without having to manually break and replace one jar at a time.

To create a simple setup place the buffered tubes in a main line from your Arcane Alembic with tubes coming out of the main buffered tube line. These standard tubes will then go directly into a warded jar. To get the essentia to flow correctly into the buffered tubes, shift right click the output side of the buffered tube with your wand untill it is red. This will change the band to a red band which will limit the suction of the Essentia.

The Essentia will be forced from the buffered tube to a normal tube then into your Warded jars. Chain your buffered tubes as needed untill all your Warded Jars will fit.
§4
Note: This system will get gunked up with essentia if any of your Warded Jars are full!

§rIf you would like more information please check out the guide 'A Thaumaturge Guide to Laying Pipe' by xlstadal for more indepth Thaumcraft 4 Tube knowledge.

§9§n[url]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fMvJ5HbeOdy4UgBMe47cggis02idxWoMDgK81SgowEo[/url]§r

An armorset worthy of a God. This breastplate provides the user infinite creative flight and removes all negative debuffs.

While wearing the complete set, you are completely unkillable.

A buffer of 64 per slot is never big enough. Just look at red alloy ingot for example. It can only hold 16 recipes worth of redstone at once. You don't really want the items to just zoom around the pipes while waiting for the machine to make room... You want to have a big chest buffering items to be processed.

Introducing the Satellite Logistics Pipes. It provides additional input into the recipe incorporating it.

The pipe runs on a numerical frequency system, with the whole server sharing the number pool. This ensures that 2 separate systems can be connected to each other without conflict.

You can "connect" a crafting module with one satellite pipe by selecting the correct frequency of the satellite part. Multiple modules can connect to a single satellite pipe.

Satellite pipe inputs are the 3 grey slots on the right of the 9 slots of the module. Only items in the 3 grey slots will be sent to satellite pipes.

§cNote: Ensure your satellite pipe has any frequency other than 0. A satellite pipe with frequency 0 will not work.
Seems like you really want to swim in essentia?

High pressure, superheated loads of energy. Check the XL Steam Turbine quest above for an explanation of the mechanics shared across all turbines.

This XL Turbine is exactly the same as the XL Steam Turbine in the way it upgrades from the regular multi: the only accepted fluid is Superheated Steam, and nothing else works. They are meant to be built together, since any steam setups you might have at this point will surely be using the two.
Are you draining an ocean?

We can process Crystal Processing Units in a Laser Engraver to get the Crystal SoC. But as our demand for circuits gradually increases, this method of production is becoming untenable. We need a more advanced way to mass produce Crystal SoCs!

For that we use a new material, Cerium-doped Lutetium Aluminium Garnet (Ce:LuAG). LuAG has better performance when making Crystal SoCs - in fact it is a laser crystal material.

First, mix Lutetium, Aluminium, Oxygen, and a little Cerium to get the material blend. Then put the blend with Molten Lutetium into an Autoclave to get a regular LuAG gem. If you have already got Oganesson you can also directly use that. As the second step, use the LuAG gem and more of the blend to produce Exquisite LuAG Gems.

After you get the first gem, you can also use your Autoclave to grow crystals. Using Vacuum Furnacee might be a better choice to produce Exquisite LuAG Gems.

Lutetium, Lutetium, it needs a lot of Lutetium. How will you to get lot of Lutetium? Check out the Powerful Nuclear Physics quest tab!
One step closer to your goal, these bees can be bred from Furious and Demonic Bees while inside the Nether. Just like their Furious counterparts, they will spawn fire charges while working.
The Ion Thruster is the advanced version of the Rocket Engine. Each Ion Thruster Base provides 25MN of force and holds up to 2,000L of Xenon. Electric power is needed, too.

Those Digital Singularities, while offering a vast amount of space, felt constraining with their ability to store only one type of item... So you came up with something different this time. Having reached the peak of technology, you managed to create and contain an Artificial Universe within a Storage Cell. This allows you to store up to 63 different types of items without the universe collapsing in on itself.

If you have been processing the ores you have gathered up until now, you will have come across a variety of crushed ores. Since these are quite dirty, you will have to clean them up to get certain byproducts. But how do you clean up this multitude of crushed ores? By using a Steam Purifier, of course! With a steady flow of Steam and a bit of Water, you can wash away impurities and get Purified Crushed Ores in no time.

If you're tired of waiting forever for your ores to clean up, this is your fix!

§3This Multiblock has two modes, the default Washer Mode and a Simple Washer Mode. Simple Washers process ores considerably faster, but they do not give byproducts. Like other Multiblocks, the mode can be toggled by the respective button inside the GUI or by right-clicking the Controller with a Screwdriver. Since all ore washing recipes are LV, this Multiblock can run all of them.
The very first tier, tier zero. This chapter will introduce you to the basic mechanics of this modpack. Mods covered: Vanilla, Pam's Harvestcraft.
This tab continues the basics until you make your first steam machine, and are ready for the real GT stuff
Steam to electricity (EU) is the progression of this tab. Most of the machines you make in this tier you'll use the whole game, if in an upgraded form.

The first "voltage" tier of this pack. Things should be a little easier with some of the machines you can now make, and almost every type of machine is now available, try not to be overwhelmed. You can get away with using LV machines for automating processing of things like polyethylene or electrolyzing water the whole game, so consider setting that up when you need it.

Your second voltage tier. Don't mix different voltage levels, or you'll have a fancy new crater. Start thinking about how to expand your base. 

BTW, for OCing purposes, this counts as tier 2, ULV doesn't count.
Finally some real power to work with. This tier is all about getting to the moon to gather more rare resources to build even more advanced machines.
Welcome to EV! You have successfully gone to the moon and processed Titanium. You are now getting extreme levels of energy. In this tier you will unlock Nuclear energy, and Applied Energistics 2.
This tier is all about the platline, and making the assembly line. They're both super hard, but necessary. This is probably where most people drop out. Good luck!

If you have made it this far, you should walk with your head held high - you are at the start of the lategame. Endgame is still a long road ahead of you, but you are now an expert at GTNH and most of the mods it comes with. Congrats, and be proud of yourself.

Once you're done being proud, start making CALs for better circuits, and work towards making endgame power with the Fusion Reactor, you'll need it.
If there's a way to generate EU, it'll be on this tab, so check back after a new milestone to see if anything became available.
Catch it, grow it, eat it!
In order to not die constantly, you'll need weapons and armor. There's also utility stuff adventure backpacks and static defenses for your base.
This set is a global tracker for multiblock structure goals. As you can build several parts of many multiblocks way earlier than the respective tier. Check back often.
Tired of torches everywhere making your base look like a loser built it? Make your base look like a winner with these quests.
Steve's Carts and ProjectRed automation, for your auto-farming and auto-crafting needs, lag included!
A questline about oil refining, oil byproducts, and oil based power generation.
These quests will give you something to use your Coins on. So come on in and and buy some useful or fancy stuff.
This tab showcases new high-speed multiblocks to replace your old machines as they become available. Check back regularly!
Automated Farms, tree breeding, and more.....
Breeding Bees for Better Bling (experimental, may cause honey leakage)
A non-tiered quest set that is meant as an in game, quest based tutorial and guide to bees. Since they are a really helpful tool to advance forward.
Questline about powergen that comes from plants and trees.
Magic lies beyond. Great achievements, but also a lot of work. I shall be your guide. Follow my instructions, and you shall become a great wizard, like me.
Warp included.
Ultimate (magical) POWER!!!
Do you know which wand focus is useful and which not? Also, some EMT stuff.
A series of questlines dedicated to nuclear fission and fusion, both for power and useful items.
Granny Weatherwax would approve.
When regular magic just won't cover it, pay demons to do it for you! The cost might scare some people... But no risk no fun!
Collection of endgame objectives, good luck and thanks for playing so far.

Congratulations, you've completed the platline, assline, CAL, §oand§r fusion reactor and made it to the Zero Point Module tier. You're well into the late game now, but there's still a lot of stuff to do. Good luck!
SFM and OC have your back for assline automation! And automating other stuff too complex for AE2, like infusion or blood altars. You can do a lot of cool stuff with OC, feel free to give it a try.
A treatise on magical herbology and Botania
You can find ways to store EU here and ways to transform between voltages.
A guide to help you start Galacticraft to reach the Moon and beyond

AE2 focuses on creating a compact, easily accessible, considerably extendible storage system called an ME Network. You can use it to autocraft items as well, and if you want to finish the pack, you will.

Treasure of lands far beyond the vast sea of the Void and very angry rune spiders await you!
All our collected wisdom, in one convenient place. Many Greggers died to bring you this knowledge.
